240-574-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5470-6965.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

1556-2645-3430-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
1556-2645-3430-4348.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1661-3499-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

254-301-7861.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat from step 2

3641-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3641-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3054-5147-5346-6809.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6158-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-6158-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4802-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-2981-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-2981-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-1796-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2719-5900-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2719-5900-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1693-3750-7025.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
1693-3750-7025.description:
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering Avatar Roku, adding six {R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Leyline Tyrant.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
1693-3750-7025.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can activate Avatar Roku infinitely to give your red creatures infinite power.

3532-3949-5078-6747.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

2228-3108-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Grim Poppet until your next turn.
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Volrath.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Volrath by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1824-2639-3254-4050.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2639-3254-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You haven't completed, or are currently venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
You control a non-Human creature
1824-2639-3254-4050.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Acererak the Archlich and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Acererak the Archlich enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Acererak the Archlich and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
1824-2639-3254-4050.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

997-2523-5562.notablePrerequisites: Stalwarts of Osgiliath is your Ring-bearer.
997-2523-5562.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Stalwarts of Osgiliath.
When Stalwarts of Osgiliath dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Stalwarts of Osgiliath that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2104-2304-3019-4377-5546.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
Temporal Manipulation and Walk the Aeons exiled by Arcane Bombardment.
2104-2304-3019-4377-5546.description:
Cast Inspiring Refrain by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling a random instant or sorcery from your graveyard, and then casting a copy of Temporal Manipulation and Walk the Aeons without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the Temporal Manipulation and Walk the Aeons copies, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain.
Move to your first extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Move to your second extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2103-4125-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2103-4125-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

437-509-549-3094-4131.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-549-3094-4131.description:
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 5.

1379-2508-2580.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Lethal Vapors triggers, destroying that creature.
Because Collector Ouphe prevents Lethal Vapors's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

1651-2410-3163.notablePrerequisites:
Gold Myr and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional Myr artifact creatures.
1651-2410-3163.description:
Activate Gold Myr by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two other Myr artifact creatures you control, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Repeat.
If you control another Myr that can tap to produce at least {1}, this combo nets infinite mana.

710-2730-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

1308-2832-3389-4050.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting Brine Comber.
Brine Comber triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward' second ability by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2510-3277-4792.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3277-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.

614-1987-3075-5116.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
614-1987-3075-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
